newsitem.title: UK: Controlled explosion carried out at Luton airport.
newsitem.headline: Controlled explosion carried out at Luton airport.

text.p: A controlled explosion was carried out at Luton airport after a suspect device was discovered in a terminal, police said.

The building had been evacuated after a coded phone warning. Earlier in the day two bombs blew up next to a major motorway in central England in what appeared to be the latest Irish guerrilla attempt to disrupt the election campaign.
